title: ReadFile
description: Read the contents of a file. The path must be inside the workspace root. Returns the file contents as a string, with line numbers prefixed (cat -n format).

path.description: Path to the file, relative to the workspace root or absolute. Must resolve to inside the workspace root (TOCTOU-safe).

offset.description: Optional 1-indexed line number to start reading from. Useful for large files.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of lines to read. Default 2000. Use offset+limit to paginate.
